verdict.rationale: Orama is documented as a fast, in-memory full-text search engine ('fast, relevant search', 'insertion is quick and intuitive') suitable for real-time query use cases, but the evidence never explicitly describes an as-you-type UI pattern or cites millisecond-level latency benchmarks. missing for 10: explicit as-you-type/keystroke-search documentation, published latency/benchmark numbers, hands-on confirmation of instant search UX.
